Pan Size Butter Eggs Milk & Flour
2-3 qts ¼ cup 3 ¾ cup each
3-4 qts ⅓ cup 4 1 cup each
4-4 ½ qts ½ cup 5 1 ¼ cup each
4 ½ - 5 qts ½ cup 6 1 ½ cup each

Select the recipe proportions to fit your pan, and get out the ingredients you’ll need.

  1. Melt butter in pan in 425° oven. Mix batter quickly while butter melts.

  2. With a rotary beater – beat eggs until light & lemon color, and gradually beat in milk, then flour.

  3. Remove pan from oven and pour batter into hot melted butter.

  4. Return to oven and bake until puffy and well-browned, 15-25 min - depending on size of pan.

Optionally dust with ground nutmeg and serve with any of the following toppings:

• Lemon and powdered sugar (or just butter and powdered sugar, our fav)
• Warm honey or maple syrup
• Fresh fruit sliced and sweetened
